verdict.rationale: Gusto documents header-based API versioning: an api-versioning page tells developers to set `X-Gusto-API-Version`. Supporting signs include date-stamped versions (e.g. `2023-02-01`, which changed error structures) and separate Postman collections per API version. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods, or how long old versions stay supported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support-window details, and independent corroboration of versioning stability.
